lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance clusters are arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows and five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating defined nodes of high luminance at the intersections along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance contrast between a highlighted dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 distinct, high-luminance spots, primarily distributed along the anterior margin and mid-section of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated white linear feature is visible on the upper mid-flank, oriented horizontally and breaking the consistent circular spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The rostrum and head exhibit a high-frequency distribution of smaller, stochastic spots that transition into the larger, ordered grid pattern of the trunk.
